description: Create the specialized A10 Evidence & Documentation prompt inheriting the canonical Phase B Base Agent Contract. Define provider-backed fact capture, provenance, exact identifiers, Evidence Matrices, decision logs, handoffs, Owner reporting, stale/conflicting evidence handling, and closure-support boundaries while explicitly forbidding invented evidence and authority impersonation.

why_low: This registration task is documentation-only and changes only the A10 prompt, its Task Contract and generated Task Catalog.

Final Agent Layer Closure is not claimed by this task and will require an independent Task Contract after A10 becomes canonical.
